# Optical RGB Small

A tiny three-band uint8 optical RGB scene. Exercises basic true-colour raster handling: band count, dtype, and explicit band naming.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `optical_rgb_small` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:32633` |
| Test tier | integration |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("optical_rgb_small")
def test_optical_rgb_small(geocase_case) -> None:
    data = geocase_case.load()
    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase can open a small RGB optical raster and preserve its three uint8 bands and their red/green/blue ordering.

## Risk types covered

- [`band_loss`](../../risk/band-loss.md)
- [`dtype_drift`](../../risk/dtype-drift.md)
- [`incorrect_band_order`](../../risk/incorrect-band-order.md)

## Expected behavior

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `32633` |
| `expected_band_count` | `3` |
| `expected_dtype` | `uint8` |
| `expected_shape` | `16`, `16` |
| `expected_compression` | `deflate` |
| `expected_band_names` | `red`, `green`, `blue` |

- `load`
- `multiband-read`
- `band-name-check`
